Bukelism; the philosophy and politics espoused by Nayib Bukele.

examples.english: This phrase was used as a disqualification of his political adversaries. Likewise, it is common to see in Bukelism a mixture of references to God with insults.
examples.ref: 2022 September 22, Luis Eduardo Aguilar Vásquez, “El bukelismo y su peligroso uso de la religión”, in Noticias UCA, archived from the original on 22 Apr 2024:
examples.text: Esta frase fue utilizada como una descalificación a sus adversarios políticos. Del mismo modo, es común ver en el bukelismo mezcla de referencias a Dios con insultos.
examples.translation: This phrase was used as a disqualification of his political adversaries. Likewise, it is common to see in Bukelism a mixture of references to God with insults.

examples.english: An example is that of Nayib Bukele, in El Salvador, which is not only reduced to "Bukelism", but also presents very strong strategic alliances between the Salvadoran State and criminal groups.
examples.ref: 2023 November, Dolores Barón, Douglas Farah, “"Lo más peligroso que estamos viviendo es el autoritarismo ideológicamente agnóstico"”, in DEF, number 150, page 90:
examples.text: Un ejemplo es el de Nayib Bukele, en El Salvador, que no se reduce solo al "bukelismo", sino que presenta alianzas estratégicas muy fuertas entre el Estado salvadoreño y grupos criminales.
examples.translation: An example is that of Nayib Bukele, in El Salvador, which is not only reduced to "Bukelism", but also presents very strong strategic alliances between the Salvadoran State and criminal groups.

examples.english: Other cases show that judges close to Bukelism officials were allowed through promotions, while others who were not aligned were forced to resign or were transferred.
examples.ref: 2024 April 10, Santiago Pereira Campos, La independencia judicial frente a los poderes políticos, Palestra Editores, page 96:
examples.text: Otros casos evidencian que a los jueces cercanos a funcionarios del bukelismo se les permitió mediante ascensos, mientras que a otros no alineados se les obligó a renunciar o se les trasladó.
examples.translation: Other cases show that judges close to Bukelism officials were allowed through promotions, while others who were not aligned were forced to resign or were transferred.

examples.english: In addition, the consortium detected 61 violations of the electoral law, where Bukelism officials and candidates inaugurated or announced infrastructure works during campaign time.
examples.ref: 2024 March 4, Gabriel Labrador, “Las elecciones municipales matizan la hegemonía del bukelismo”, in El Faro, archived from the original on 22 Apr 2024:
examples.text: Además, el consorcio detectó 61 violaciones a la ley electoral, donde funcionarios y candidatos del bukelismo inauguraron o anunciaron obras de infraestructura en tiempo de campaña.
examples.translation: In addition, the consortium detected 61 violations of the electoral law, where Bukelism officials and candidates inaugurated or announced infrastructure works during campaign time.

examples.english: Bukelism's greatest risk at this time is not that its security strategy is copied, of which we still do not know many details, inapplicable in other Latin American contexts, in form and substance, but that its public discourse is copied.
examples.ref: 2023 September, Sergio Maydeu-Olivares, “Bukele y la tentación del autoritarismo en América Latina”, in CIDOB, archived from the original on 22 Apr 2024:
examples.text: El mayor riesgo del bukelismo en estos momentos no es que se copien su estrategia de seguridad, de la cual desconocemos todavía muchos detalles, inaplicables en otros contextos latinoamericanos, en forma y fondo, sino que se copie su discurso público.
examples.translation: Bukelism's greatest risk at this time is not that its security strategy is copied, of which we still do not know many details, inapplicable in other Latin American contexts, in form and substance, but that its public discourse is copied.

glosses: Bukelism; the philosophy and politics espoused by Nayib Bukele.
